name: Variable-scoped shadowing Deny (false-allow guard)
note: Canonical home-directory pattern: Allow s3:* on *, then Deny s3:* on the caller's own private prefix via ${aws:username}. The Deny's applicability is only knowable after runtime substitution. A literal glob would fail to match the '${...}' text, skip the Deny, and report the request ALLOWED_BY_POLICY - a false allow. Correct behavior: the variable Deny keeps the request CONDITIONAL, never a definitive allow.
